notes: The requested hook is not present. Its full ScreenshotEvent contract needs a decision on exposing the captured image to mods: the renderer currently reads and writes it internally, and mod_api has no screenshot/image type. The issue specifies file and message changes but not image access or mutation; I could not establish the 26.3 counterpart's image contract from the available public documentation. No code or PR was created. The older public NeoForge javadoc describes image access and a cancellation message, so omitting these would risk an incomplete counterpart. The renderer also writes HDR before the normal screenshot, which the design must account for when cancellation forbids file writes.
